what: GE2340 WalkSense positioning evaluation. Every number here is computed by crossday.py from committed data.

settings.knn: k=5 (fewer if fewer training samples), distance-weighted, standardised
settings.visit_level: majority vote over all windows/chunks of one stop
settings.fusion: barometer step-tracking floor (threshold learned on the other day) picks a per-floor model
settings.wifi_features: rssi = strongest RSSI per BSSID in a 10 s chunk, -100 if not heard; presence = heard or not

devices.normalisation: no per-device calibration; magnitude-only magnetic features ignore phone orientation; Wi-Fi presence features ignore RSSI offsets between the two Samsung phones
